To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed an efficient NMR experiment that correlates, at very high spectral resolution, the aliphatic proton and carbon side-chain resonances of a protein to the attached backbone N–H resonances.
we developed a fast 3D HC–co–NH experiment that provides high resolution aliphatic side chain and backbone assignments.
a 3D experiment combining joint H–C co-evolution with NUS allows to assign the side-chain resonances in 2 day experiments.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new NMR experiments that can be used to obtain high-resolution aliphatic proton assignments of protein backbone and side-chain protons.
developing NMR methods for the rapid assignment of backbone and side-chain resonances in proteins.
the development of NMR methods for protein structure determination.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the new approach is a powerful tool for high-resolution protein structure determination, especially in cases where the protein under study is not amenable to standard NMR methods.
the combination of RD experiments and NUS is a very powerful and efficient approach to obtain high-resolution 3D and 4D NMR data.

the combination of the two techniques described above, namely, joint evolution of alphatic side-chain proton–carbon coherences and NUS, has the potential to become an important and valuable tool for protein NMR resonance assignments.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
this method provides a new tool for rapid and accurate backbone and side-chain assignment of large proteins.
this approach is a powerful and robust tool for high-resolution aliphatic proton/carbon assignments in medium-sized proteins, and can be easily extended to larger proteins.
this approach allows one to obtain high-resolution side-chain assignments in a few days, and can be easily implemented on any spectrometers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
NUS and RD can be used in a synergistic way to obtain high-resolution data in 3D experiments.
, with the help of RD and NUS, the acquisition and analysis of 3D experiments can be made much faster, more efficient and less laborious.
the combination of RD and NUS strategies is a very powerful approach that allows the acquisition of high-resolution data sets in a very short time.
